findings.issue: Standard Details subsections (`**Files**`, `**Dependencies**`, `**Edge cases**`, `**Implementation hints**`) are absent; content is written as free-form paragraphs. For a QA/non-code task `**Files**` and `**Implementation hints**` are semantically N/A, but `**Dependencies**` and `**Edge cases**` are present as prose (tasks 8/9/10 dependency paragraph; local-infra unavailability edge case). Template expects labelled subsections.
findings.fix: Optionally restructure Details into labelled subsections for template conformance: `**Dependencies**` (tasks 8, 9, 10 must be done), `**Edge cases**` (Docker unavailable for slow lane; local infra missing for AVP step 4 — fallback documented). `**Files**` and `**Implementation hints**` can be omitted or replaced with N/A notes for a verification-only task.
